feeds.title: Indie Music Review
feeds.description: An indie music review blog showcasing the latest releases from indie artists all over the globe. Articles cover album reviews, MP3s downloads, music videos, concert reviews, tour dates, and more.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound
feeds.description: Obscure Sound is an indie music site that I formed in February 2006 out of a love for finding new and emerging quality music. My name is Mike Mineo and I'm the site's founder and editor. This site aims to provide music fans with the latest and greatest music, preferably from artists you've never heard of before.

feeds.title: The Static Dive
feeds.description: StaticDive.com is a music blog featuring independent Pop, Rock, and Electronic artists from around the globe. Here you can find brief intros and reports consisting of Information on Artists and their latest works. The site is also home to Experimental Electronica artist The Static Dive (aka Bob).

feeds.title: Raven Sings The Blues » Indie
feeds.description: Listen to independent artists and music shared by Raven Sings The Blues in this segment of the blog. Raven Sings The Blues started in 2006 as a collaboration between three co-workers. Now it is a site covering psych, garage, indie, electronic, experimental, and crucial reissues.

feeds.title: The Ark of Music
feeds.description: Explore Music News and Reviews from the Ark Of Music. The Ark of Music strives to enrich the music culture by connecting independent and small-label musicians with the music-loving public. We are dedicated to discovering and providing greater exposure for the unheard-of, independent, and small-label musicians of planet Earth.

feeds.title: Oh My Rockness
feeds.description: New York City's indie concert calendar. Find show and band recommendations, venue info, tickets and more.

feeds.title: Joe Tell's Music Blog
feeds.description: Music Blog covers the Underground/Indie Rock Music Scene in a positive manner with a focus on the WNY area. Bands and promoters are encouraged to submit promo material for review. Listening to new music with an open mind is important. This blog isn't about Joe Tell it's about exposing new music and promoting new bands that want a push. I also post about any interesting topic that may cross my mind. Music blog sponsored by Buffalo's best comic book shop Queen City Bookstore.

feeds.title: IndieWavves Music Blog
feeds.description: IndieWavves is an independent music blog. Its focus is to share the new wav(v)e of emerging acts in music in a creative and unconventional manner. This is done by incorporating social media, video journalism, music streaming services, and partnerships with artists on the rise. We aim to make your experience in discovering your next music obsession fun, unexpected, and unique.

feeds.title: Indie is not a genre
feeds.description: Indie is not a genre is an independent music blog that covers new Indie albums, reviews, interviews and concert livestreams. We are an independent source for new music from the UK, Australia, Canada and beyond.

feeds.title: Elevtr
feeds.description: A COMMUNITY MUSIC AND VIDEO BLOG FILMING LIVE MUSIC CREATING ARTIST DOCUMENTARIES, MUSIC REVIEWS, COVERING GRASSROOTS ISSUES

feeds.title: UNXIGNED
feeds.description: UNXIGNED is a crowdsourced, genre-fluid music and artist discovery blog that aims to help independent artists be heard globally and to provide them with a unique press framework that grows their value, relevance, and fan base.

feeds.title: Rolling Stone
feeds.description: Rolling Stone is an American monthly magazine that focuses on music, politics, and popular culture. It was founded in San Francisco, California in 1967 by Jann Wenner and the music critic Ralph J. Gleason. Get the latest Rolling Stone news with exclusive stories and pictures from Rolling Stone.

feeds.title: Hot Indie News » Music Reviews
feeds.description: Hot Indie News is an online news resource with a progressive vision. It serves as an alternative voice to mainstream media and provides a forum for creativity, activism and self-discovery. The editorial focus is experiential and down to earth and embraces a creative, socially conscious way of life. Features include a beyond the mainstream slant on politics, the arts, health and spirituality, lifestyle options, offbeat humor and more.
